content: MK describes the Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī (Yazdī's correspondence, poetry and incidental writings, often attributed to his brother Qivām al-Dīn, d. 830/1427) as having seven items (eight in MS Majlis-i Sinā 316) concerning Ibn Turka or the Turka family. It often appears in hybrid collections with early Timurid epistolary material such as the Tuḥfa-yi Nuṣratī of Abū Bakr Iskandarī.
